readQuestion: Read the current crystal and report its formula, space group number, cell atom count, and independent orbit count.

reference.description: The structure of Al2Au is cubic with space group Fm-3m (No. 225), containing 12 atoms per unit cell—8 Al and 4 Au—distributed across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 10 geometric neighbors (6 Al, 4 Au) and Au centers with 8 Al neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. Polyhedra sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Al and Au coordination polyhedra, corner- and face-sharing among Al polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Au polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional connected component.
